verdict.rationale: Cubic offers some data portability — CSV export of analytics data, an Analytics API for PR-level data, and wiki content exported as markdown files directly into the repo — but there is no documented comprehensive 'export everything and leave' capability covering review history, configs, or full account data. missing for 10: a full account/data export mechanism, explicit data-portability or account-deletion documentation, independent confirmation that exports are complete enough to migrate away.
